stories.title: Shane Gillis's SNL monologue
stories.summary: Shane Gillis hosted Saturday Night Live, and his monologue, including a bit mocking women who wear revealing outfits at the gym, set off days of argument. Dan Levy said he was "speechless that something like that can exist on live national television," fans called it his best yet, and women answered by tagging him in their gym selfies. Later in the show he dropped a live F-bomb in a sketch. NBC's monologue clip got 42K likes and Pop Crave's F-bomb clip 49K.
